description: Convert a contact list (CSV/Excel with columns like Name, Phone, Email, Company) into a .vcf file for phones and address books. vCard 3.0 or 4.0. Processed in memory, nothing stored. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/csv-to-vcard.
